facts: Parties: Marlow Medical Ltd (Buyer), Hartwell Medical Ltd (Seller); the Company is Juniper Marine Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 8 June 2026; Closing is scheduled for 19 August 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 8 June 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 20 November 2026.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Kingsmere Industries Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
